title: Running through a gravity-changing course
description: Continuous wall and ceiling movement through connected course rooms.

title: Dashing around obstacles
description: Aim, preview a route, dash around an obstacle, and land at the target.

title: Rewinding a movement sequence
description: Move through a turn, rewind past the ghost, and finish back on the recorded route.

title: Two ants hauling an object
description: One ant drags, another joins, and the object responds as an ant lets go.

title: Falling and getting back up
description: An ant tumbles, recovers, and immediately walks or turns again.

title: A working island and a new job
description: Companions work and deliver resources while one changes jobs and starts its new task.

title: Currency, crates, and collected cosmetics
description: Spend in-game currency on a rotating crate and show the item added to the collection.

title: Round results and rewards
description: Finish a round, read the leaderboard, and see the confirmed currency reward.

title: The currency shop purchase flow
description: Choose a currency offer and show the real purchase prompt. Grant verification is a separate check.

title: Inventory and progress after returning
description: Equip an owned trail, leave, and return to compare the saved collection and currency.

title: Moving items into storage
description: Transfer a fish or supply from inventory into a chest and show the updated contents.

title: Weather changing the island
description: A readable weather transition with the same island and camera position in view.
